name: scramble-reveal
title: Scramble Reveal
description: A deterministic hacker-style text reveal that cycles fixed glyph rows and locks the target string from left to right. Monospace on purpose: a terminal look is code, and code stays monospace (brand: Bebas Neue and Montserrat for words, monospace for code).

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Target string that resolves from deterministic wrong glyphs.

variables.label: Style
variables.description: Terminal frame or clean text-only presentation.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the locked string holds until the frame cuts.
